title: A Warm Welcome from the Psychological Counseling Center
content:
分類： 行政公告
來源： 心理諮商輔導中心 - 陳淑惠 - csh12967@gms.ndhu.edu.tw - 電話8906276
對象： 全校教職員_全校學生
標題： A Warm Welcome from the Psychological Counseling Center
日期： Wed, 26 Feb 2025 08:49:55 +0800

Dear Faculty and Students of Dong Hwa University,
Welcome to a new semester! We hope you enjoyed a restful and fulfilling holiday. As you begin this fresh chapter, you might feel excited yet a bit nervous or anxious—that’s perfectly natural.

We are pleased to share that the Psychological Counseling Center’s website has been updated for the new semester. We invite you to visit it at https://pcc1.ndhu.edu.tw/en/home/ to explore our latest activities, services, and our new “Care Reporting Mailbox.” If you notice anyone who may need our support, please reach out to us through the mailbox. We will do our utmost to respond promptly. In case of an emergency, please call us during office hours at 03-8906896 or contact the campus security 24-hour hotline at 0937-295995.

Throughout the semester, you’ll gain new knowledge, forge new friendships, and perhaps face challenges. Remember, we are always here to support you. If you ever feel overwhelmed, please don’t hesitate to reach out for help.
Counseling Center Hours:

During the semester
Monday–Thursday: 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM
Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
During non-semester periods
Monday–Friday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
Location: Student Activities Center, 1st and 2nd Floors, Side B

Wishing you a wonderful and meaningful semester ahead!

Sincerely,
Psychological Counseling Center
